name: hub-stop-all-operator
description: #1408: /hub stop all typed in a session stops agents it did not launch in its own folder, leaves an agent in another folder running, and names that folder with the --everywhere command. Every process pins HOME and KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT to the fixture so no step can reach the developer's hubs; never runs --everywhere (the shared socket root would reach the developer's agents).

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-stop-all"; PP="$R$(printf ":%s" "$R"/packages/*/src)"; cd "$H/ws"; HOME="$H" KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT="$H/ws" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 PYTHONPATH="$PP" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

setup.description: fixture HOME: alpha and beta detached in ws/, gamma detached in other/, each folder its own hub root
setup.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-stop-all"; PP="$R$(printf ':%s' "$R"/packages/*/src)"; for d in ws other; do [ -d "$H/$d" ] && (cd "$H/$d" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT="$H/$d" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 PYTHONPATH="$PP" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub stop all >/dev/null 2>&1); done; rm -rf "$H"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws" "$H/other"; printf '%s' '{"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"openai-test","profiles":{"openai-test":{"provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.5","base_url":"https://api.openai.com/v1","api_key":"sk-test-dummy","supports_tools":true}}}},"plugins":{"hub":{"enabled":true}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; touch "$H/.kollab/connect-guide-seen"; for a in ws:alpha ws:beta other:gamma; do d="${a%%:*}"; (cd "$H/$d" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT="$H/$d" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 PYTHONPATH="$PP" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --detached --as "${a##*:}" >/dev/null 2>&1); done

steps.title: typed /hub stop all stops this folder's agents

steps.description: alpha (not launched by this session) stopped
gamma in another folder is named, not stopped
the command that stops other folders is shown

teardown.description: stop every fixture agent, folder by folder (never --everywhere); runs even when a step failed
teardown.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-stop-all"; PP="$R$(printf ':%s' "$R"/packages/*/src)"; for d in ws other; do (cd "$H/$d" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT="$H/$d" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 PYTHONPATH="$PP" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub stop all) || exit 1; done
